exception_registry.policy: exact path + exact reason + classification; one file per exception; no directories, no patterns, no detector-level exemptions

scope.scope_note: explicit inclusion list; historical evidence archives are covered by the documented historical-evidence policy (Phase 1 inventory + Phase 15 policy record), not silently ignored

verdict_note: PASS only when every in-scope file exists, the exception registry is structurally valid, and zero machine-local paths are found; any missing scope entry, broken registry, stale exception or violation fails the gate
